mascot: Nibbles the Mouse — a tiny, squeaky mouse with a songbook who rhymes everything with cheese... please!

slides.title: What Is a Rhyme? 🎶
slides.text: Rhyming words end with the same sound! Cat and hat rhyme. They both end with -at. Rhymes are word friends!
slides.spoken: Rhyming words end with the same sound, like cat and hat!

slides.title: The -at Family 🐱
slides.text: Here is the -at family: cat, hat, bat, mat, rat. Change the first sound and you get a new rhyme!
slides.spoken: Cat, hat, bat, mat, rat — the -at family all rhyme together!

slides.title: The -ig Family 🐷
slides.text: The -ig family loves to dig: pig, big, wig, dig. Say them out loud — they all end the same!
slides.spoken: Pig, big, wig, dig — the -ig family all rhyme!

slides.title: Rhymes in Songs 🎤
slides.text: Songs and poems are full of rhymes. Twinkle twinkle little STAR... how I wonder what you ARE! Star and are rhyme!
slides.spoken: Songs are full of rhymes, like star and are!

slides.title: Rhyme Makers ✨
slides.text: Now YOU make rhymes! If you know cat, you know hat! If you know sun, you know fun! Let's find the rhyming friends.
slides.spoken: You can make rhymes now! Cat-hat, sun-fun. Let us play!

challenges.question: Which word rhymes with 'cat'?
challenges.hint: Say cat... hat... they end with the same sound, -at!
challenges.misconception: Hat rhymes with cat — both end with -at! Dog and cup end with different sounds.

challenges.question: Which word rhymes with 'star'?
challenges.hint: Star... car... listen to the ending: -ar!
challenges.misconception: Car rhymes with star — both end with -ar! Sun and tree do not.

challenges.question: Do 'hen' and 'pen' rhyme?
challenges.hint: Say hen... pen... do they end with the same sound?
challenges.misconception: Hen and pen both end with -en, so yes, they rhyme!

challenges.question: Which word rhymes with 'cake'?
challenges.hint: Cake... lake... they both end with -ake!
challenges.misconception: Lake rhymes with cake — both end with -ake! Milk and book do not.

challenges.question: Drag each word! Does it rhyme with 'cat' or not?
challenges.hint: Hat and bat end with -at, just like cat. Dog and sun end differently!
challenges.misconception: Hat and bat rhyme with cat (they end with -at). Dog and sun end with other sounds, so they do not rhyme!

challenges.question: Which word rhymes with 'snail'?
challenges.hint: Snail... tail... they both end with -ail!
challenges.misconception: Tail rhymes with snail — both end with -ail! Shoe and ship do not.

challenges.question: Which two words rhyme?
challenges.hint: Say each pair out loud. Which two end with the same sound?
challenges.misconception: Sun and fun both end with -un, so they rhyme! The other pairs end differently.

challenges.question: Drag each word! Does it rhyme with 'pig' or not?
challenges.hint: Big and wig end with -ig, just like pig. Moon and star end differently!
challenges.misconception: Big and wig rhyme with pig (they end with -ig). Moon and star do not!
